scope: Read-only review of four differentiable bridges, shared formatting/representation/schema helpers, author numerical test oracle and source-bound evidence. Independently executed six additional cases per SDK.
authorEvidenceSourceHashes: all verified to match current files
method: Direct dense gate expansion and forward tangent-state derivative propagation; independent of author parameter-shift references, SDK autodiff and SDK gradient calls.
coverage: Four-qubit asymmetric circuits with complex Y/S/T phases and reversed/nonadjacent controlled gates
Three independent-axis rotations with reordered selected gate indices including indices >=10; unselected rotations remain constants
Duplicate Pauli-observable rows; Identity expectation and stationary/zero-angle derivatives
Idle qubits and q0-most-significant public ordering; no-gradient shape
Raw state norm and probability serialization consistency; socket connections blocked during all runs
limits: DeepQuantum retains native complex64 construction error in fixed gate constants; this independent sample saw maximum gradient error 6.79e-8. It remains disclosed, unnormalized and not promoted to scientific Acceptance.
Tests cover supported ideal CPU state-vector gate semantics on this host; no noisy/photonic/MPS/GPU/distributed paths, cloud services or actual hardware were evaluated.
This review did not re-run Harness integration or alter other agents files.
